parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag value of the service. This value is used to ensure that the modified service is consistent with the service to be modified. The ETag value is returned in the responses of the [CreateService](~~175256~~), [UpdateService](~~188167~~), and [GetService](~~189225~~) operations.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start time when the function is invoked. Specify the time in the yyyy-mm-ddhh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The definition of the service version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open publish-service-version --service-name demo-service --description test_description --if-match e19d5cd5af0378da05f63f891c7467af --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id rid281s000000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
